$comment: The application's capability policy for the incident-agent route: the versioned allow-list of tools the model may be offered, and the scope rule each call must satisfy. MCP servers propose tools; only this policy grants them (R-15), and the guard checks every request before a call is made.

not_granted.$comment: Tools the servers expose that this route never offers the model. close_ticket changes state; it needs a human.
